Separate outDir per suite — see tests/tsconfig.registry.json for why. `lib/correction.ts` is I/O-free (types only besides its own logic); `lib/restatement.ts` adds only `lib/score-engine.ts`'s exported types, and `lib/score-engine.ts` itself is a pure computation module (no Supabase client, no clock except injected args). That is what makes O.3's outcome classification and O.4/V.6.9's restatement decision provable with no live database in reach (U.3, the determinism boundary). The I/O modules (`lib/correction-server.ts`, `lib/score-recompute-server.ts`, `lib/evidence-deletion.ts`, `lib/account-deletion.ts`, `lib/data-export.ts`) are deliberately NOT compiled here — they import `lib/supabase-server.ts`, which requires a live project, and are exercised instead by tsc/build (already green) and by structural assertions over their source text.
